assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Historical water-crane (水鹤) installations along the Jing-Zhang Railway and any related heritage remains require professional and archival verification; the proposal uses the water crane only as a design leitmotif and does not assert any specific physical remains.
assumptions.impact: Heritage-related narrative and the water-history trail (JZ-07) remain conceptual until verified.

assumptions.statement: Compute cooling water consumption and heat-recovery figures are design assumptions only; no operational data is available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Cooling-transparency scenarios are concept proposals; quantitative claims require measured data.

assumptions.statement: Six international ecosystem case studies are used as design analogies from public sources; they are not planning controls and do not imply replication commitments.
assumptions.impact: Case tables remain background reference; no commitments inferred.
